title: Ask whether to save session when logging out
line: With "Restore manually saved session" enabled, the logout screen now has a Save Session button, so you can choose to save your open apps right before you log out.
explanation: The logout screen only offered actions that end or suspend the session; whether the session is saved was decided only by the global setting. In "Restore manually saved session" mode the only way to save was the Save Session entry in Kickoff/Kicker or KRunner, which users who log out from the power button or a panel widget never see. Also, ksmserver's performLogout scheduled a retry when a save was still running but then carried on anyway, so a logout right after a save ran on top of the unfinished checkpoint. The logout screen now shows Save Session (same icon and label as the launcher entry) when the manual mode is on; it saves through the existing SessionManagement::saveSession() path, stops the countdown and relabels itself "Session Saved", and ksmserver now returns after scheduling its retry so the logout waits for the save to finish.

commits.message:
logout-greeter: offer to save the session from the logout screen

With "Restore manually saved session", the only ways to save were the
launcher menus and KRunner. The greeter now forwards a save request from
the logout screen, and ksmserver lets a running save finish first.

BUG: 46923

desktoppackage/logout: add a Save Session button

With "Restore manually saved session" enabled, the logout screen gave no
way to save the session before leaving. It now shows a Save Session
button that saves the open apps and stops the countdown, like Kickoff.

BUG: 46923

patches.diff:
From a43a1e99820d5f8c87e0924121a6397468d39efc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:28:45 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage/logout: add a Save Session button

With "Restore manually saved session" enabled, the logout screen gave no
way to save the session before leaving. It now shows a Save Session
button that saves the open apps and stops the countdown, like Kickoff.

BUG: 46923
---
 desktoppackage/contents/logout/Logout.qml     |  1 +
 .../contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml        | 22 +++++++++++++++++--
 2 files changed, 21 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/logout/Logout.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/logout/Logout.qml
index 35f7ea6345..6b673ec3c3 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/logout/Logout.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/logout/Logout.qml
@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@ Item {
     signal cancelRequested()
     signal lockScreenRequested()
     signal cancelSoftwareUpdateRequested()
+    signal saveSessionRequested()
 
     function sleepRequested() {
         root.suspendRequested(2);
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml
index 04349c4ebe..5811e32bf7 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/logout/LogoutControls.qml
@@ -15,6 +15,8 @@ import org.kde.breeze.components
 
 import org.kde.plasma.private.sessions
 
+import "timer.js" as AutoTriggerTimer
+
 Item {
     id: controls
     Kirigami.Theme.inherit: false
@@ -287,17 +289,33 @@ Item {
                                           : i18nd("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "&Log Out Now")
                 onClicked: controls.hostRoot.logoutRequested()
                 KeyNavigation.left: shutdownWithoutUpdatesButton
-                KeyNavigation.right: cancelButton
+                KeyNavigation.right: saveSessionButton
                 focus: sdtype === ShutdownType.ShutdownTypeNone
                 visible: canLogout && (sdtype === ShutdownType.ShutdownTypeNone || controls.showAllOptions)
             }
+            LogoutButton {
+                id: saveSessionButton
+                objectName: "saveSessionButton"
+                property bool saved: false
+                icon.name: "system-save-session"
+                text: saved ? i18nd("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "Session Saved")
+                            : i18nd("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "Sa&ve Session")
+                onClicked: {
+                    AutoTriggerTimer.cancelAutoTrigger();
+                    saved = true;
+                    controls.hostRoot.saveSessionRequested();
+                }
+                KeyNavigation.left: logoutButton
+                KeyNavigation.right: cancelButton
+                visible: canSaveSession
+            }
             LogoutButton {
                 id: cancelButton
                 objectName: "cancelButton"
                 icon.name: "dialog-cancel"
                 text: i18nd("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "&Cancel")
                 onClicked: controls.hostRoot.cancelRequested()
-                KeyNavigation.left: logoutButton
+                KeyNavigation.left: saveSessionButton
                 KeyNavigation.right: suspendButton
             }
         }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, "Restore manually saved session" on: the logout screen has no way to save the session
Patched: Save Session button next to Log Out
After clicking it: "Session Saved"; ksmserverrc gets [Session: saved by user] and the fallback state lists konsole and dolphin
Log Out pressed on the same screen, new session: the restore helper brings back konsole and dolphin
Log Out-only countdown screen: the button is there too, the Right key moves to it and stops the countdown, Space saves
